children.text: Introduction & Basic Info
children.cn: 引出人物与基本信息

children.text: Lei Xiaofeng is my best friend.
children.cn: 雷小锋是我最好的朋友。
children.statement: 本句为题干中预先给出的开头语句。
children.explanation: 题干开头已给出，按规则不计入总词数。

children.text: He is 13 years old and he is in Class 1, Grade 7.
children.cn: 他今年13岁，在七年级一班。
children.statement: “in Class 1, Grade 7” 表示所在的班级和年级。
children.explanation: 表达班级和年级时，班级在前且首字母大写。

children.text: Hobbies & Family
children.cn: 爱好与家庭情况

children.text: He likes sports, and basketball is his favourite sport.
children.cn: 他喜欢运动，篮球是他最喜欢的运动。
children.notes: favourite sport = 最喜欢的运动
children.statement: “favourite” 在句中作定语修饰名词 sport。
children.explanation: favourite 意为“最喜爱的”，符合提示表格中的爱好信息。

children.text: He always plays it with me on the playground after school.
children.cn: 放学后他总是和我在操场上打篮球。
children.notes: play sth. with sb. = 和某人一起玩……；after school = 放学后
children.statement: “after school” 是表示时间的介词短语。
children.explanation: after school 意为“放学后”，作时间状语。
children.keywords: always plays, with me, playground, after school

children.text: Fruit and vegetables are his favourite food.
children.cn: 水果和蔬菜是他最喜爱的食物。
children.notes: fruit and vegetables = 水果和蔬菜
children.statement: 主语为复数概念，be动词用 are。
children.explanation: Fruit and vegetables 属于并列主语，谓语动词用 are。

children.text: He says eating healthy food makes him strong.
children.cn: 他说吃健康的食物能使他强壮。
children.notes: make sb. + adj. = 使某人处于某种状态
children.statement: 动名词短语 “eating healthy food” 作从句主语。
children.explanation: 动名词作主语时谓语动词用单数 makes。
children.keywords: eating, healthy food, makes him strong

children.text: He has a brother and a sister, and they are students too.
children.cn: 他有一个哥哥（弟弟）和一个姐姐（妹妹），他们也都是学生。
children.notes: brother and sister = 兄弟姐妹；too = 也
children.statement: 本句涵盖了表格中的家庭成员信息。
children.explanation: 完整体现了提示表格中 A brother and a sister 的要点。

children.text: Spirit & Conclusion
children.cn: 雷锋精神与文章总结

children.text: He is friendly to everyone and always helps others.
children.cn: 他对每个人都很友善，总是热心帮助别人。
children.notes: be friendly to = 对……友善；help others = 帮助他人
children.statement: “be friendly to” 意为对某人友好。
children.explanation: 体现了雷锋助人为乐的优良精神品质。
children.keywords: friendly to everyone, always helps others

children.text: I like Lei Xiaofeng because he is a true role model.
children.cn: 我喜欢雷小锋，因为他是一个真正的榜样。
children.notes: role model = 榜样；because 引导原因状语从句
children.statement: “because” 引导原因状语从句说明喜欢他的原因。
children.explanation: because 用于解释原因，使文章主题得到升华。
children.keywords: like Lei Xiaofeng, because, true role model

children.text: Introduction & Profile
children.cn: 高级引言与个人概况

children.text: Lei Xiaofeng is my best friend.
children.cn: 雷小锋是我最好的朋友。
children.notes: 题目给出的固定开头句。
children.statement: 题干中已给出的起始句，两个范文中须保持完全一致。
children.explanation: 根据GEMINI.md规范，已给出句子保持100%一致且word_count为0。

children.text: He is a 13-year-old middle school student who always studies hard.
children.cn: 他是一名13岁的初中生，总是勤奋学习。
children.notes: 13-year-old = 复合形容词作定语；who 引导定语从句
children.statement: 句中使用了 who 引导的定语从句修饰 student。
children.explanation: who 引导限制性定语从句，丰富句式结构。

children.text: Lifestyle & Family
children.cn: 生活习惯与家庭背景

children.text: He has a great passion for sports, especially basketball, which is his favourite.
children.cn: 他非常热爱体育运动，尤其是篮球，那是他的最爱。
children.notes: have a passion for = 对……充满热情；especially = 尤其是
children.statement: “which” 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 basketball。
children.explanation: 使用 which 引导从句，展示高级语法运用能力。
children.keywords: passion for sports, especially basketball, favourite

children.text: After school, we often practice together on the playground to improve our skills.
children.cn: 放学后，我们经常在操场上一起练习以提高球技。
children.notes: practice together = 一起练习；to improve = 动词不定式作目的状语
children.statement: “to improve our skills” 属于动词不定式作目的状语。
children.explanation: to do 不定式表目的，使语意更加明确充实。
children.keywords: After school, practice together, improve our skills

children.text: In addition, fruit and fresh vegetables are his favourite daily food.
children.cn: 此外，水果和新鲜蔬菜是他日常最喜欢的食物。
children.notes: In addition = 此外（过渡词）；daily food = 日常食物
children.statement: “In addition” 作为副词短语用作段落连接过渡词。
children.explanation: In addition 增强段落间的逻辑连贯性。
children.keywords: In addition, fruit, fresh vegetables, daily food

children.text: He believes that a balanced diet keeps him energetic and healthy.
children.cn: 他坚信均衡的饮食能让他保持充沛的精力和健康。
children.notes: balanced diet = 均衡饮食；energetic = 精力充沛的
children.statement: “that” 引导宾语从句作 believes 的宾语。
children.explanation: 运用宾语从句及 energetic 等高级词汇阐述健康理念。

children.text: He lives with his parents, a younger brother and an elder sister.
children.cn: 他和父母、一个弟弟以及一个姐姐生活在一起。
children.notes: live with = 与……一起生活；younger brother = 弟弟；elder sister = 姐姐
children.statement: 准确交代了家庭全部成员关系。
children.explanation: 紧扣提示表格中 A brother and a sister 的要点要求。
children.keywords: lives with, parents, younger brother, elder sister

children.text: Lei Feng Spirit & Inspiration
children.cn: 雷锋精神与升华启示

children.text: Whenever someone is in need, he is always ready to offer a helping hand.
children.cn: 每当有人需要帮助时，他总是乐意伸出援助之手。
children.notes: Whenever = 每当（从属连词）；offer a helping hand = 伸出援助之手
children.statement: “offer a helping hand” 是地道的高级成语表达，意为提供帮助。
children.explanation: 形象生动地诠释了新时代“雷小锋”助人为乐的优良品质。
children.keywords: Whenever, in need, offer a helping hand

children.text: Everyone loves Lei Xiaofeng because he truly spreads warmth and kindness like Lei Feng.
children.cn: 每个人都喜欢雷小锋，因为他真正像雷锋一样传递着温暖与善意。
children.notes: spread warmth and kindness = 传递温暖与善意；like Lei Feng = 像雷锋一样
children.statement: 文章结尾通过呼应“雷锋精神”升华主旨。
children.explanation: 深刻呼应题目“争做新一代雷锋精神传播先锋”的写作背景。
children.keywords: loves Lei Xiaofeng, because, spreads warmth, kindness
